Question

Let’s say you want to make a spirolateral.

If the turn angle is \(\theta=96^{\circ}\) and the maximum segment length is \(n=16\), then which spirolateral is created?

You can use this tool:

https://artockthedino.github.io/pbl/spirolateral/spirolateral_generator.html


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct answer is H.

Below I’ve listed the parameters used to generate all patterns:

  • A:
    • Turn angle = 144
    • Count max = 19

  • B:
    • Turn angle = 120
    • Count max = 17

  • C:
    • Turn angle = 135
    • Count max = 19

  • D:
    • Turn angle = 36
    • Count max = 18

  • E:
    • Turn angle = 45
    • Count max = 10

  • F:
    • Turn angle = 126
    • Count max = 18

  • G:
    • Turn angle = 90
    • Count max = 19

  • H:
    • Turn angle = 96
    • Count max = 16
